crossRefs.note: “Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let none of it…
but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come…
that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech…
Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;
and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal…
For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
“Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I…
Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the…
For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also…
I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”
For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to…
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on…
For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”
Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she…
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be on Babylon!” the inhabitant of Zion will say; and, “May my blood be on the inhabitants of Chaldea!” will Jerusalem say.
translations.bsb: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon,” says the dweller of Zion. “May my blood be on the dwellers of Chaldea,” says Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
translations.asv: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and, My blood be upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
